question: Can a completely unseen third raw surface family acquire only a context-derived representation and then use transition knowledge learned from two other surface families without any task-transition examples of its own, after removing a benchmark construction alias between true motifs and fixed boundary windows?
hypothesis: With 32 distinct family-independent raw context keys per latent entity, each of the twenty-seven true surface motifs will occur exactly 32 times while every non-true four-byte bridge window occurs at most 4 times. The top-27 raw selector will therefore recover all twenty-seven motifs, context signatures will induce exactly nine correct three-member alias classes, and a class-transition learner trained only on families 0 and 1 will achieve at least 0.95 accuracy on all eighty family-2 tasks. Exact-surface will have all eighty keys missing and at most 0.25 accuracy; the frozen shuffled-family2 bridge will remain at or below 0.25.

supersedes_invalid_before_execution_or_c.reason: fixed post-motif context caused motif-suffix overlapping four-byte windows to tie true motifs at 32 occurrences, so the frozen top-27 selector admitted boundary artifacts and decode validity failed before a scientific claim

repair_boundary.unchanged: surface families, family-2 zero-task-training rule, representation width, top-27 selector, context-signature equality induction, task corpus, class transition learner, exact-surface control, shuffled semantic rotation, evaluation set, scientific accuracy thresholds
repair_boundary.reason: remove a deterministic benchmark encoding collision rather than increase capacity, alter selection, or weaken thresholds

authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

bridge.normal_assigned_entity: semantic entity for all three families
bridge.signature: complete sorted map of exact four-byte immediate context key -> occurrence count
bridge.shuffled_family2_assignment: value semantic +3 mod 4; operation semantic +1 mod 5

scientific_core.surface_selection: top twenty-seven four-byte windows by occurrence count descending, then lexicographic raw key
scientific_core.task_training: families 0 and 1 only; all five operations x sixteen value pairs x twenty repeats per family
scientific_core.class_transition: induced operation class plus ordered induced value-class pair -> observed induced output-class pair counts
scientific_core.evaluation: all eighty family-2 single-step tasks, read-only

validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The twenty-seven evaluator-defined true motif identities are used only for construction diagnostics and post-selection scoring, never to seed or filter the selector.
All thirty-two immediate context keys per assigned entity are distinct and are family-independent.
Normal clustering receives only observed raw context signatures and no family, semantic, or alias mapping.
Family 2 has zero task-transition training records.
Exact-surface and shuffled controls remain unchanged except that shuffled family2 uses the repaired context-key generator with the same frozen semantic rotations.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution and all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, selector-capacity increase, threshold weakening, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and unseen-family accuracy materially exceeds both controls, but at least one 0.95 transfer or representation-recovery threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but unseen-family transfer does not materially outperform exact-surface.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any construction separation, bridge decoding, family-2 isolation, evaluator-boundary, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No bridge formula, surface family, selector, capacity, learner, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
